name: Beat the Box-and-One
idea: When one defender chases your best shooter everywhere, set a screen on that chaser to get your shooter open.
why: In a box-and-one, four defenders guard a box near the basket and one chases your best shooter. A screen stops the chaser, and the box defenders don't leave their spots to help, so your shooter gets a wide-open shot.
tryit: Shooter: run your defender toward the basket first, then come back hard off the screen with your hands ready. Screener: stand still with your feet wide so the chaser bumps into you.

frames.say: Red is playing a *box-and-one*. Four defenders guard a box by the basket, and {X2} follows our best shooter, {2}, everywhere.
{2} runs toward the basket, but {X2} sticks to {2} the whole way.
{4} runs over and sets a *screen* on {X2}. Screens work great on a defender who chases one player.
{2} runs around the screen and {X2} gets stuck. The box defenders stay in their box, so {2} is open!
{1} passes to {2}. {X2} has to run all the way around {4}!
{2} drains the three! When a defender chases your best shooter, a screen sets the shooter free.
